# INSIGHTS — summarized, verified findings (accumulate across the whole run)

The JOURNAL is your per-iteration diary; THIS file is the distilled, VERIFIED takeaway a future iteration should read instead of re-reading the whole journal or old sessions/traces. Update it whenever you have a genuinely NEW, confirmed finding (an accepted/rejected RESULT counts as confirmation; a guess does not) — not every iteration needs a new entry. Structure each addition as:

    ## <task or mechanism name>
    - What worked (confirmed by a RESULT, cite the candidate id):
    - What didn't (confirmed by a RESULT, cite the candidate id):
    - Promising but not yet tried:

<!-- cap-evolve:insights-append-below -->

## Reservation identification (tasks 17, 22)
- Promising (shipped cand_0001, not yet confirmed): when a user describes a trip without an id, the seed forces N× get_reservation_details on bare ids from get_user_details, and the mid model grabs the wrong one. A `list_user_reservations` tool returning per-reservation origin/dest/dates/pax gives the discriminating data in one call. Verified offline it surfaces FQ8APE (EWR→ORD) for omar_rossi_1241.

## Argument-filling friction on writes (tasks 8, 23)
- Promising (shipped cand_0001): mid model uses `date_of_birth`/`type`/`id`; pydantic hard-errors and the agent loops. In-body alias normalization is a strict no-op on canonical keys, so it is regression-safe. Pair with literal per-param docs stating the exact keys.

## Payment total (tasks 8, 23, 25)
- Promising (shipped cand_0001): single-payment amount is unambiguous (= full total), so auto-filling it removes a whole retry class with zero blast radius on multi-method or correct calls.
